extraction.name: CommonCatalog
extraction.description: A dataset of roughly 70 million open-licensed Creative Commons images with synthetically generated captions produced using a pre-trained BLIP-2 model, designed for training text-to-image diffusion models.
extraction.creator: Aaron Gokaslan, A. Feder Cooper, Jasmine Collins, Landan Seguin, Austin Jacobson, Mihir Patel, Jonathan Frankle, Cory Stephenson, Volodymyr Kuleshov
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was constructed by sourcing Creative Commons licensed images from YFCC100M, excluding images with non-derivative (ND) licenses. Images were divided into commercial (C) and non-commercial (NC) categories. All images were then captioned using the BLIP-2 OPT2.5B model, with images center-cropped and resized to 512x512 pixels for captioning (though kept at native resolution for training). The captioning process required approximately 1,120 GPU A100 hours.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: YFCC100M Creative Commons licensed images, which were divided into approximately 70 million non-commercial (NC) images and a subset of approximately 25 million images that can be used commercially (C). The raw images rarely had alt-text captions and when present, often just included image titles or URLs.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Synthetic captions were generated for Creative Commons images using a pre-trained BLIP-2 model. The process involved using BLIP-2 to perform 'lossy compression' from high-dimensional images to low-dimensional text captions, creating image-caption pairs for training.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: BLIP-2 model pre-trained on LAION-400M was used to generate synthetic captions for Creative Commons images
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset contains biases related to temporal currency, as the YFCC100M data is about a decade old and CC images are not as current as those in LAION-2B. The models also under-perform in some categories, particularly faces.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has data incompleteness and scarcity issues associated with Creative Commons images. The data is temporally limited (about a decade old) and not as current as alternative datasets. Models trained on this data under-perform in certain categories like faces.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training text-to-image latent diffusion models. The dataset is specifically designed for training models on only Creative Commons licensed images with synthetic captions.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Future plans include augmenting CommonCatalog with Creative Commons images from other sources and testing larger CommonCanvas model architectures.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The dataset uses aspect ratio bucketing and micro-conditioning techniques as part of the SDXL architecture implementation.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The preprocessing involves curating Creative-Commons licensed images from YFCC100M dataset, filtering for high-resolution images, and generating synthetic captions using a pre-trained BLIP-2 model through a transfer learning technique called 'telephoning' that converts images to text captions.
